name: ARX-CLOT 4 Channel
summary: Semi-automatic 4-channel coagulometer using a turbodensitometric principle with automatic start. Runs PT, APTT, fibrinogen, TT and single factors (FII–FXII) as an open system, with 15 incubation positions, a 7" touch screen, built-in thermal printer and memory for 1,000 results.

specs.label: Assays
specs.value: PT, APTT, fibrinogen (g/L, mg/dL), TT, single factors (FII to FXII)

specs.label: Units
specs.value: Seconds, % activity, ratio, INR, g/L, mg/L

specs.label: Calibration
specs.value: Reference curves editable up to 9 measurement points

specs.label: Printer
specs.value: Integrated thermal printer; optional external printer

specs.label: Interface
specs.value: RS-232C; optional data transfer to SD card or external PC

features: Methods can be created, edited, copied and deleted
On-board storage for up to 20 assays
Automated result calculation in seconds, %, INR, g/L, mg/dL and ratio
Calibration curves editable up to 9 points
Optional data transfer to SD card or external PC
